scope: All14 tracked blobs read including implementation, license, README, setup/build and configuration.

findings.finding: 8x9 pixels produce72 hash bits, but sum is divided by64 and similarity uses64. Black is all72bits, white zero; Hamming72 maps to Python2 integer score -13. No calibrated confidence claim.
Truthful nonzero memory cache hit skips source existence and mutation checks. Persistent record with future created timestamp is accepted for changed non-image bytes.
Nonempty JSON formatter emits trailing comma and cannot be parsed; empty list emits valid JSON.
Zero hashes are treated as absent during pair comparison, dropping valid computed zero signatures.
All file pairs scanned quadratically; per-pair hash accesses may stat and fetch persistent records. Pair results and async result list unbounded by explicit budgets.
Worker readiness observed without get(), so hash exceptions are not collected as typed per-file errors. Callback stat/save failures lack recovery guards.
Directory separation uses startswith string prefix rather than path containment. Nested/overlapping roots can suppress eligible pairs or duplicate discovered paths.
No EXIF orientation normalization, frame policy, pixel confirmation or low-information guard; strict greater-than confidence100 cannot return any match.
Lock acquire/release lacks finally on several IO paths. Photos-library choice is raw string then choice-1. Setup entrypoint calls main without CLI globals initialization.
Bundled ez_setup may download/install setuptools; read in full but never executed. No upstream tests or tracked media in tree.

limits: Full tracked source/license/configuration read, all Git blobs and canonical tree objects verified; no tracked images/GIF/video.
Reference concepts only; no foreign production code adopted.
Static review is not complete runtime, cross-platform, image-quality or scale qualification.
Selected converted methods only, explicit storage adapter and real modern Pillow;8 authored controls twice. Original Python2/BlitzDB/pool/CLI not executed.
